topic: Theory: Shirahoshi's cries are the hidden trigger that the Fish-Man Island arc and the Noah contract both depend on
title: Shirahoshi's Tears Were The Plot's Hidden Trigger
description:
Shirahoshi looks like a crybaby in the Fish-Man Island arc, but her tears are the mechanism that calls the Sea Kings and ties Poseidon to Joy Boy's broken promise. This theory breaks down why the crying was a deliberate plot device from the start, and why it may pay off again.

Do you think her tears are a weapon the story is building, or a plot crutch Oda leans on when Luffy needs a fight? Tell me which side you're on.
